favourite.heading: Why Florida International can pull away
bullets: Florida International is the better football team by 5.5 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 86% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+5.5 pts).
Playing at Florida International is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 1.8 points to Florida International (+1.8 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Buffalo can keep it close
bullets: Stylistically the matchup favours Buffalo by 0.7 points: ball control vs front disruption (-0.7 pts).
The outcome range is 15.5 points wide at one sigma — p10 -13.2 to p90 +31.8 for Florida International, so a projection of +10.8 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 6%.
60% of the model’s own input contract was empty for this game — no starter, injury or per-player talent context reached it, so the number leans on team strength more than it should.
